title: STRONGHOLDS
why: His yes to strongholds: one or two advertised fortified compounds per raid, each with a gate, two defending waves and a purple-or-better cache. Every raid now plans one or two strongholds from its seed, and the alert and both maps show them from the start, with an arrow at the edge of the minimap. A stronghold is a ring of steel mesh fence about 240 across: nobody crosses it, you, the machines and the pillagers alike, though bullets fly through the mesh. Inside is the garrison, three sentries and three crawlers. The gate is on the side facing where you dropped: stand at it from outside for three seconds and a ring fills round it, the gate is breached for good, it makes a loud noise, and the second wave comes at you from inside: three elite crawlers, a Bulwark and a sentry. The cache in the middle holds four items, every one purple or better, and shows on the maps once the gate is open. Clear the garrison and the second wave and the stronghold pays a 1,000 chip into your run score. The Director never lands a pack inside one. DEMO and CAREER work the same.
now: Each raid has one or two fenced strongholds on the map: breach the gate, beat two waves, take the purple cache.
